Title: Regression net and SQLite-focused tests
Purpose: Strengthen the test net so future process-module changes immediately reveal pack drift, loader regressions, sidecar loss, or SQLite-sensitive behavior changes.
Deliverables: Additional unit tests for pack materialization and sidecar parity
Integration tests for import metadata and SQLite-sensitive paths
Updated validation scripts and explicit command list
ReviewQuestions: Will future drift in template files or loader behavior be caught immediately?
Do the tests cover the missing-pack scenario that slipped through previously?
Are SQLite-sensitive paths explicitly tested rather than assumed?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a regression corrective subbundle and do not proceed to final review until the gap is closed.
